<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs`; edit the source it names instead. -->

Upgrade cuilo to the newest release, with the package manager that installed it, if any.

## Usage

```sh
cuilo upgrade [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--check` | Only report whether a newer release exists. |
| `--version <VERSION>` | Install this version instead of the newest, e.g. `2.0.0`; it may be older. Not for Homebrew. |

## Global options

`--root`, `--json` and `--no-input` work here too; see [global options](/reference/cli/#global-options).
